headline: Himachal rains: Several roads remain blocked; check full list here
content: SHIMLA: Several roads in Himachal Pradesh remained closed on Tuesday after heavy rains and landslides in various parts of the state.At least 51 people were killed as rains wreaked havoc in Himachal Pradesh.The weather office predicted extremely heavy rains in nine out of 12 districts of the state, barring Kullu, Kinnaur and Lahaul and Spiti, and issued a yellow warning for Tuesday.Rain News Live Updates:The following is the list of roads that are blocked- NH 21 Mandi-Kullu Via Pandoh road blocked at various places due to landslide.- Mandi-Kullu via Kataula road blocked at various places due to landslide.- Sundernagar- Chail Chowk –Gohar- Kullu road blocked at various places due to landslide.- Mandi to Janjehli road blocked at various places due to landsliding and Janjehli-Karsog via Raigarh blocked due to land sliding and Janjehli to chatri road blocked at Magru gala.- Mandi to Karsog via Rohanda blocked at Baghyar, Chambi due to land sliding, Karsog to Luhri road blocked at Kotlu/Shilh and Karsog to Shimla Road blocked at Parga gali and thogi due to land slide.- Mandi to Dharampur blocked at Saroli and Dharampur to Sandhol road blocked at Sarauri, Sakloh due to land slide.Dharampur-Sarkaghat road blocked at various places due to land slide.- NH 154 Mandi –Padhar road blocked at various places due to land slide.- Nerchowk-Kalkhar , Rewalsar road blocked at various places due to land slide.- NH 21 Mandi to Sundernagar road open.- Sundernagar to Slapper Road blocked at Bhawana.Situation of roads in Shimla 102737493 102737483
